forWhat: The one list of materials the school uses, each under the category it files under. Classes and the store pick from it, so a thing is never typed twice.
Everyone on the staff reads it. A coordinator or a founder changes a category and teaches a word.

layout.shows: Find an item by its name or by a word approved for it. The category list narrows the page to one category.
Each category is a group of items with their unit and approved words. Items with no category come first, so none is missed. A group shows a few items, and [[Show all →]] opens the rest.
A coordinator or a founder sees a list and a [[Save]] button on each row. Everyone else reads the category in the group's name.
Above the groups, a coordinator or a founder has [[Teach a word]], which sets many items at once.

jobs.title: Find an item
steps: Type part of the name in the search at the top.
The page shows only the items that match, still in their categories.
To see one category, choose it in the category list.

jobs.title: Give an item its category
steps: Find the item. Items with no category are in the first group.
In its row, choose a category and press [[Save]].
The item moves to its category. The change is kept with your name.

jobs.title: Teach a word
steps: Choose a word that many items end in. The commonest words come first.
Choose the category it files under, and press [[Teach the word]].
Every item with no category that ends in that word takes the category, and the page says how many. The word is kept, so a new item with that word files itself.
An item whose category a person chose is never changed by this.

jobs.title: Add an item that is not in the list
steps: Open an item picker, such as the one on Stock or on the class list, and type the name.
If the picker says Did you mean, look at those names first. A name close to an item that exists never makes a second item.
If the item is not there, press [[Not in the list? Add it]].
Type the name and the unit, and choose the category. Each one is needed.
Press [[Add to the list]]. The new item is picked at once.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.does: Gives the item the category you chose in its row.
buttons.doesNot: It does not change the item's name or its unit.

buttons.label: Teach the word
buttons.does: Sets the category of every item with none that ends in the word, and keeps the word.
buttons.doesNot: It does not change an item that already has a category.

buttons.label: Not in the list? Add it
buttons.does: Opens the form for a new item.
buttons.doesNot: It adds nothing until you press Add to the list.

buttons.label: Add to the list
buttons.does: Makes the new item and picks it at once.
buttons.doesNot: It does not make a second item when the name is one that exists.
